description: Paracelsus’s attempt to reshape Warehouse history gives way to the team’s last cases and a final reckoning with what the Warehouse has meant to all of them.

s05e01.description: In “Endless Terror”, Pete, Myka and the Warehouse team confront another artifact-driven crisis, racing to identify the object and contain its effects before the damage spreads.
